name: data-pipeline
title: Data pipeline
summary: Every table has an owner, a schema check and a freshness check.

rules.text: A schema change ships with its migration.
rules.why: a schema that changes without its migration breaks every job that reads the old shape.

rules.text: A failed job names the rows and the reason.
rules.why: a failure that names no rows means rerunning everything to find what broke.

items.title: Every schema change has its migration
items.criterion: Every table's schema in the code is produced by its migrations, so a schema change without a migration fails the tests. tests/test_migrations.py checks each table against its migrations without touching the warehouse and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- the migrations folder
- tests/test_migrations.py
Test:
- tests/test_migrations.py compares each declared table schema with the one its migrations produce, offline

items.title: A failed job names the rows and the reason
items.criterion: When a job fails on bad input, its error names the rows that failed and why. tests/test_job_errors.py feeds a job one bad row from a local fixture and fails before the change.
items.brief:
Files:
- the job code
- tests/test_job_errors.py
Test:
- tests/test_job_errors.py runs a job on a local fixture with one bad row and checks the error names that row and the reason
